name: dandelion-prod
description: Prod-Lite for Dandelion: a first cut (or a project folder or Google Drive link), a brief and the new world become a finished master. People are kept as shot, researched AI backgrounds go behind them, then a grade, titles and a render at the cut's exact length with its own sound. Five agents, two sign-off gates, one board where every decision is a person's, and a research server for reading the web.
